name: Africa Mega Agricorp Plc
source: Kenya Orchards Limited audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2023, IFRS for SMEs, filed with the Nairobi Securities Exchange, in Kenya shillings. The issuer renamed to Africa Mega Agricorp Plc by certificate of change of name dated 16 December 2024, so these accounts are filed under the former name and are keyed here to the listing ticker AMAC. The filing is a scan with no text layer, so the figures stored were re-read from it by OCR on 22 September 2026: revenue 70,546,688 and 51,503,465, gross profit 11,218,972, profit before tax 2,573,755, profit for the year 1,767,471, total equity 27,242,450, total current assets 116,177,445, current borrowings 2,228,258, net cash from operating activities 233,525 and the net increase in cash 178,525 all appear on the filing exactly as stored. Operating Expenses is the sum of the printed administrative, selling and distribution and establishment expenses plus the printed loss on valuation of shares. Operating Profit (EBIT) is gross profit less operating expenses and equals profit before tax plus finance costs. Income Tax is stored positive as an expense, so profit before tax less income tax equals net profit, which is the convention most of the stored statements use. EPS is in Kenya shillings per share. | NSEBLOCKED 17 Nov 2026: the newest published annual report is the 2023 accounts, released 3 April 2024. The document registers at africanfinancials.com (company ke-orch, the pre-December-2024 code ORCH) and at decypha.com both end at 2023, and no FY2024 or FY2025 audited statement has been filed since the company was renamed Africa Mega Agricorp. | NSEBLOCKED 20 Nov 2026: the newest annual financial report published for this security is the 2023 report, filed 24 March 2024. The issuer renamed from Kenya Orchards Limited to Africa Mega Agricorp Plc on 16 December 2024 after an 84 per cent stake transfer, and no 2024 or 2025 annual report has been published under either name. Confirmed against the disclosure list at https://decypha.com/en/company-list/Africa-Mega-Agricorp-Plc-63901, whose newest annual entry is 2023, and the NSE filing library, whose newest audited statement for the issuer is the year ended 31 December 2023.
